name: Guayama (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Three unequal horizontal stripes of black, yellow and red, the broad black stripe charged at the hoist with a yellow mill, the Molino de Vives.
history: Guayama is a city and municipality on the Caribbean coast of Puerto Rico. The black stands for the enslaved Africans brought to Guayama, the yellow for the sugar-cane industry and the red for the blood shed by the Taíno against the colonisers.

features.role: old sugar mill, the Molino de Vives
